inicio.titulo: AI Consultant: from diagnosis to measured value
inicio.lead: Building with AI has become cheap. The hard part is choosing the right process, testing small, and proving it was worth it. In eight lessons you learn to help owners and the board adopt AI with diagnosis, priorities, a pilot, and measurement.
inicio.capa_alt: A consultant's desk at a distributor: a notebook with a four-quadrant matrix, reports, and the warehouse in the background.
inicio.aulas_sub: Each lesson has a diagram, a template to copy, a practice with a "done when" and a commented quiz. The practice is always in the same company: Horizonte Distribuidora.

itens: People who want to help owners and the board adopt AI with a method, without selling a tool.
Professionals in processes, management, IT, or consultative sales. No programming needed.
People who already build with AI and want to move on to diagnosing, prioritizing, and measuring.

blocos.t: What you will be able to do
itens: Lead a 45-minute discovery conversation and leave with the baseline.
Prioritize opportunities by value and feasibility, including when NOT to use AI.
Compare models and vendors by the cost per task, with human review included.
Design a 30-day pilot with a stop criterion, measure at 30/60/90 days, and write the one-page proposal.
This course is part of Professional 2030: one common core, four training paths, and a lab.
Each training path will have an INEMA certification; details soon. It is a qualification certificate, not a regulated profession.
Common Core: Trust what AI builds · Lab: Horizonte Distribuidora
